question_vi: Partial clone và shallow clone: khi nào dùng trong CI/CD để tăng tốc pipeline?
question_en: Partial clone and shallow clone: when do you use them in CI/CD to speed up pipelines?
answer_vi:
**Full clone** của large monorepo (Facebook-scale) có thể mất 30+ phút. CI/CD cần tối ưu.

```bash
# Shallow clone — chỉ lấy N commits gần nhất, tốt cho CI/Docker build:
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/org/repo

# Partial (blobless) clone — tải trees, defer blobs tới khi checkout file; phù hợp nhất cho CI:
git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/org/repo

# Sparse checkout — chỉ checkout 1 phần của monorepo:
git clone --no-checkout https://github.com/org/monorepo && cd monorepo
git sparse-checkout init --cone
git sparse-checkout set apps/my-app packages/shared
git checkout main
```

Trong GitHub Actions: `actions/checkout@v4` mặc định `fetch-depth: 1` (shallow); đặt `fetch-depth: 0` khi cần full history (semantic-release, changelog).

Treeless clone (`--filter=tree:0`) không tải trees — checkout gần như không dùng được, chỉ cho special cases (shallow inspection), không phải CI thông thường.

**CI/CD best practice**: `--depth 1` + `--filter=blob:none` + sparse checkout = clone time giảm 90% cho large monorepos.

**Lưu ý**: shallow clone làm `git bisect` và `git log --all` không hoạt động đầy đủ
answer_en:
**Full clone** of a large monorepo can take 30+ minutes. CI/CD needs optimization.

```bash
# Shallow clone — only the last N commits, good for CI/Docker builds:
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/org/repo

# Partial (blobless) clone — downloads trees, defers blobs until checkout; best for CI:
git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/org/repo

# Sparse checkout — only check out part of a monorepo:
git clone --no-checkout https://github.com/org/monorepo && cd monorepo
git sparse-checkout init --cone
git sparse-checkout set apps/my-app packages/shared
git checkout main
```

In GitHub Actions: `actions/checkout@v4` defaults to `fetch-depth: 1` (shallow); set `fetch-depth: 0` when full history is needed (semantic-release, changelogs).

Treeless clone (`--filter=tree:0`) downloads no trees — nearly unusable for checkout; only for special cases like shallow inspection, not regular CI.

**CI/CD best practice**: `--depth 1` + `--filter=blob:none` + sparse checkout = 90% reduction in clone time for large monorepos.

**Note**: shallow clone breaks `git bisect` and `git log --all` because history is incomplete
